patch_description: Reconceptualizes the classifier as a QAOA circuit for a data-defined Ising model. It completely removes artificial two-qubit entanglers from the ansatz, relying entirely on the dense all-to-all IsingZZ feature map for entanglement. It uses independent RZ gates to learn local field feature weights, followed by highly parameter-efficient collective RY and RX transverse mixers. This eliminates over-entanglement barren plateaus and dramatically reduces circuit depth.
